messages:
mike (PM): quick sync — BigRetail wants a negotiated cutover: they need a 45d grace window and the ability to soft-pin a portion of traffic while we validate. what minimal product + legal guards do we need?
sanjay (Eng): runtime will need per-tenant pin records + pct routing and a soft-fallback. propose feature-flag store entry and lightweight routing override. API sketch: POST /v1/catalog/pins {tenant_id, model_id, pct, ttl_days, grace_mode}.
tara (Research): validation plan: produce 3k paired prompts per tenant cohort (short/medium/long). compute embedding cosine, normed logprob delta, and token-distribution shift. suggest daily spot-check: 50 human-reviewed prompts.
elaine (Legal): contract note: some enterprise deals require 30d written notice before breaking compatibility. if customer asks for 45d grace, CS must confirm contract exceptions and preserve consent logs for audits. retention 6 months.
jess (CS): operational ask: show "grace_until" in console, a one-click Unpin for CS, and CSV export of pinned tenants with expiry and approver. also want preflight email template for customers.
sanjay (Eng): rollback triggers proposal: embed_cos_mean drop >0.06 OR error_rate delta >0.4% sustained 20m -> pause routing. embed_drop >0.08 for 30m OR p95_latency_delta >60ms -> auto-rollback. will implement `rctl catalog rollback --cohort COHORT`.
ops-bot: scheduled canary for model-omega -> internal-beta at 2026-09-01T08:00:00Z. monitors: p95_latency, error_rate, embed_cosine_mean.
tara (Research): acceptance thresholds (MVP): embed_cos_mean >= 0.94, median logprob_delta within [-0.12, +0.06], human-spot-fail_rate < 1.5%. tag failing examples and surface top 10 in UI when a threshold trips.
elaine (Legal): add consent capture: who approved pin/unpin, timestamp, tenant_id, and exportable CSV. also approve wording: "By enabling grace mode you consent to continued delivery of legacy outputs for TTL days." we'll draft language.
jess (CS): customers ask for per-tenant extended TTLs (60/90 days) — can CS grant extensions without engineering? need admin API `POST /admin/pins/extend` with RBAC.
sanjay (Eng): ok. will add admin endpoint + audit log. also will wire estimator: preflight estimated_cost_delta returned by API. cap per-cohort spend via quota.
mike (PM): summary/action items: (1) Eng: API + routing + rollback CLI (sanjay), (2) Research: canonical samples + evaluator + thresholds (tara), (3) CS: console copy, CSV exports, customer email & confirm contract exceptions (jess), (4) Legal: consent + notice language (elaine), (5) Ops: dashboards + circuit-breaker alerts (ops team). follow-up demo Thurs 10am. :calendar:
